source.precision: Float32 source vertex positions/normals/UVs; Uint32 indices; full transforms

quality.textures: source resolution, base color sRGB, data maps linear, anisotropy 8

passes.ownership: GPU screen/depth cluster lists for every authored finite point light
passes.name: Cluster light assignment
simulation
passes.ownership: single bounded frame update for navigation, day/night, actors

passes.name: direct shadows
passes.contributors: every complete visible source mesh including instances and characters

lighting.direct: single sun + readable moon fill; full-detail sun shadows
lighting.localized: Source-authored finite point lights evaluated by native Three.js 0.186.1 ClusteredLighting plus emissive materials
lighting.reflections: material BRDF; no planar or ray-traced reflection pass

clusters.capacity: At least 64 lights and never lower than the entire authored light count; no list truncation

lighting.shadowFocus: Walking: player position. Aerial: inspected orbit target. Full source contributors and original 4096 resolution are retained.

sky.purpose: Encloses the complete authored outer terrain from every permitted broad orbit

cache.geometrySharing: Exact source geometry, large repeated groups instanced; smaller components merged by material within 150m cells; unchanged spectators shared in eight angular instance groups
cache.collision: prototype triangle BVH with exact transformed instances and spatial hash; separate from beauty geometry

shaderPreparation.scope: Every complete source main and direct-shadow pipeline, including off-camera content, prepared before exploration.
shaderPreparation.runtimeFlags: Original visibility and frustum-culling flags restored before readiness.
shaderPreparation.invalidation: Ordinary renderer camera/light/material updates remain active. No cached shadow or render-command reuse.
shaderPreparation.progress: Main and shadow preparation have distinct progress phases; shadow batches yield to the loading UI.

cache.characterPrimitives: Exactly compatible full primitive attributes and indices concatenated; original linear RGB baked into vertex colors on a cloned otherwise-identical material. No welding, normal reconstruction, triangle loss, texture compression or LOD. Tintable tunics and uniform stone overrides stay separate.
cache.skeletons: Identical bone-reference/inverse-matrix skeleton wrappers consolidated only within one actor; actor bones and animation mixers remain independent.
cache.rejectedExperiment: Static WebGPU command bundles failed pixel-equivalence checks and are absent from the production renderer; no private engine adapter is applied.

navigation.support: Layer-aware five-sample footprint support using downward exact-triangle rays; grounded-only stair stepping, with airborne landing limited to the current foot height plus 1 cm tolerance.
navigation.blocking: multiheight, body-width swept rays with axis sliding
navigation.bounds: Physical authored walls, closed gates and bank grilles form the visible boundary. Source-authored XZ bounds are the final fallback beyond the enclosure.

aerial.panning: Horizontal plane with target XZ clamped to source navigation bounds
aerial.authoredInspectionViews: Exact source camera viewpoints, including underground rooms, are preserved separately from free orbit safeguards
aerial.surfaceClearance: Actual upward-facing source triangles at five camera-footprint samples, with cached probes during stationary views; authored source inspection views bypass the constraint.

validation.sourceHashes: recorded by scripts/validate.mjs after final source export
validation.status: Resolved profile; final evidence and hashes in runtime_validation.json and source_validation.json
validation.reproducibleInstall: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund passed on Node 22.15.0 / npm 10.9.2
validation.performance: Actual WebGPU frame/CPU/GPU-render timings, source/build hashes and before/after scenarios are recorded in performance_optimization.json.

simulation.locomotion: Exact authored 3D polylines, constant speed across sampled waypoints, independent source animation phases
simulation.interaction: Walking actors wait on their lane within 0.9m of the player and 0.64m of another actor, crossfading authored Walk and Idle clips; no solid crowd walls
simulation.sourceTiming: Player and pedestrian waits affect runtime timing only; route geometry and complete source GLB meshes remain unchanged
simulation.materialVariation: Authored palette tint on RomanTunic material only, shared by asset and color
simulation.staticCharacterBatching: Full canonical geometry instanced by role/material and 64 m district cells; seating uses paired radial sectors. Standard camera/light frustum culling retains all visible geometry and shadow contributors.
